verdict.rationale: Godot documents a `headless` display server plus a `Dummy` audio driver for running without a GPU/display (godot-docs-19, godot-docs-27) and a full command-line interface (godot-docs-3, godot-docs-12, godot-probe-4), which together make it plausible to script and execute code headlessly in CI. However, there is no evidence of an official unit/integration testing framework, test runner, or documented CI recipe for asserting test results against the real engine — EditorScript's _run() is described only as an editor-menu action (godot-docs-5/20), not a CLI-invokable test harness. Missing for 10: an official test framework/runner, documented CI workflow examples, and evidence of assertions/exit codes for pass/fail reporting.
